source.title: How to judge if a meeting is efficient: An efficient meeting has no to-do list left behind, because all the actions are done DURING the meeting (either by agents who listen to the meeting in real time or by humans) The gap between saying and doing should be zero, and meetings become work sessions where things actually get DONE。
